elements.name: roadmap-subtitle
elements.text: Proposed delivery approach and evidence to proceed; dates are planning targets.

elements.name: detailed-roadmap
elements.text:
Stage	Timing	Delivery approach	Decision to proceed
0  Prove	Dec 2026	One journey; agree intent, Atlas fields,
Pega overlap and interface.	Scope, contracts and
owners accepted.
Readiness	Jan 2027	Prove identity, approved reads, typed result
and selected SDK / API path.	End-to-end, timeout and
late-result checks pass.
1  MVP target	Feb 1–28, 2027	Context before routing; human fallback.
Voice-agent readiness gates self-service.	BSC launch acceptance;
support and rollback ready.
2  Widen	Mar–Jun 2027
Monthly releases	Expand validated intents toward Top 20;
agent assist has separate release gates.	Context, wait, routing,
quality and cost accepted.
Phase 2
discovery	Q2 2027
Parallel work	Design all-LOB routing, digital journeys,
callbacks and supervisory assistance.	Pilot scope, signals, owners
and capacity agreed.
3  Pilots*	Q3 2027	Pilot selected flows; validate exact Pega
function transition where selected.	Service continuity and
attributable value accepted.
4  Expand*	Q4 2027	Scale proven inbound scope; retire only
accepted migrated Pega AI functions.	Sustained value and
operational ownership.

elements.name: roadmap-note
elements.text:
Schedule conflict: source plan has Mar–Apr pilot / May–Jun production; February target needs reconciliation.
*Proposed allocation. Outbound and additional channels remain future scope.
